snippet.title: Yoyo's Puzzle Park (Gussun Paradise) - Sony Playstation 1 (Gameplay Video)
snippet.description:
YoYo's Puzzle Park is a Puzzle game, developed by Irem and published by JVC Digital Studios, which was released in Europe in 1999. It was released 3 years earlier in Japan under the name 'Gussun Paradise'.
A fantastic one screen arcade platformer, similar to Bubble Bobble.
